title: The MedPerturb Dataset: What Non-Content Perturbations Reveal About Human and Clinical LLM Decision Making

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping or removing gender markers in clinical vignettes and measuring the subsequent changes in treatment recommendations (such as self-management, visitation, and resource allocation) from both human clinicians and large language models.

Modifying the surface-level language of patient messages to include uncertain phrasing (hedge words) or a colorful/colloquial tone, and evaluating how these non-clinical stylistic shifts impact the treatment decisions made by humans and models.
